<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Provision an access token"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/tokens"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Provisions a new access token. Either bind it to an account, or set `permissions` - an instance-wide token that is not narrowed reaches every account and every endpoint, so the API declines to mint one. A token can not mint one less restricted than itself: when the calling token has an address allowlist, a referrer allowlist, a rate limit or an expiry, the request has to repeat each of them at least as narrowly (addresses within its allowlist, referrers from its list, a rate no higher, an expiry no later), otherwise it is refused with 403.
